description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for accessing LoanTermVariations entities, including custom query methods for retrieving loan term variation data based on different criteria.

classes.name: LoanTermVariationsRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for LoanTermVariations entity, providing methods to query loan term variations with custom JPQL queries.

methods.name: findLoanTermVariationsByLoanId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of LoanTermVariationsData for a given loan ID, ordered by the applicable term date.

methods.name: findLoanTermVariationsByLoanIdAndTermType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of LoanTermVariationsData for a specific loan ID and term type, ordered by the applicable term date.

methods.name: findLoanTermVariationsByExternalLoanIdAndTermType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of LoanTermVariationsData for a loan identified by external ID and a specific term type, ordered by the applicable term date.

methods.name: findByIdAndLoanIdAndTermType
methods.description: Finds a specific LoanTermVariations entity by variation ID, loan ID, and term type.
